## Context

During execution-phase plan review, batched overlap-judge calls took 216–311 seconds and returned oversized malformed JSON with runaway candidate_id content. The final catch safely abstained, but only after multiple long generations. Phase 1 proved the overlap call inherits generic 16,000-token, three-structured-attempt, four-transport-attempt, and 600-second-per-request budgets; it declares no overlap-local limits. The original 9022 story and ADR 0086 require a bounded advisory classifier whose timeout/error/malformed output degrades promptly to abstention. Runtime evidence is recorded in `rebar:22da-e9a6-63e7-49e5` comment timestamp 1786251659444495001; the c403 live valid six-candidate/599-output-token evidence is recorded in `rebar:c403-cc3a-2c6d-4b9d` comments.

## Proven root cause

`judge_batch` builds a native structured `RunRequest` without operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-retry, or timeout bounds. Generic runner policy therefore permits three full structured generations and transport retries before the advisory catch executes. A token cap alone still retried three times; schema validation alone acted only after the oversized payload existed. The durable runtime proof is recorded in the Phase 1 RCA comment cited above.

## Repair plan

- Extend the internal `RunRequest` budget contract with lowering-only per-request seams for structured-output retries, transport attempts, and request timeout, preserving current defaults for every existing caller. Keep `output_token_limit` as the existing lowering-only output seam.
- In `runner._effective_config(base, req)`, lower `timeout_s` and `llm_retry_max_attempts` before `run()` calls `_pai_model(cfg)`. The resulting effective `LLMConfig` therefore reaches `anthropic_model.py` / `bedrock_model.py` transport construction, including an injected/shared `PydanticAIRunner`, because that runner reconstructs the model/provider for each `run(req)`.
- Apply the request-local structured-retry seam separately in both native and prompted branches of `_pai_structured`; apply the existing output-token seam through `build_model_settings`.
- Give overlap judge calls explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens (the c403 live valid six-candidate response used 599), one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and a 60-second request timeout. Any bound hit continues through the existing logged safe-abstention path.
- Preserve valid verdict demultiplexing and aggregation behavior byte-for-byte outside budget metadata.

## Testing

- Unit/contract tier through the real `judge_batch` → `PydanticAIRunner` structured path with a deterministic FunctionModel. Prove the fixture reaches malformed runaway output, the current path is RED by making three attempts/inheriting 16K, and the repaired path makes one bounded attempt then returns exact all-candidate abstention.
- Settings-seam tests prove `_effective_config` lowers timeout/transport policy before model construction, while callers omitting limits retain current settings.
- Negative control: a valid six-candidate verdict under the bounded request retains label-keyed mapping and relation behavior.
- Mutation: remove the overlap-local limits and confirm the held-out oracle returns RED.
- Original-path replication: run an overlap-enabled plan-review scenario and record elapsed time, output size/finish reason, abstention result, and timestamp on this ticket; confirm no fabricated overlap finding.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A runaway overlap response is capped at 1,024 output tokens; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k runaway`.
- [x] A malformed overlap response makes one structured generation; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k runaway`.
- [x] A failed overlap request makes one transport attempt; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k transport_attempt`.
- [x] An overlap request carries a 60-second request timeout; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k request_budget`.
- [x] Timeout, truncation, and malformed output each return exact all-candidate abstention; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k bounded_abstention`.
- [x] Valid batched verdicts retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py`.
- [x] Callers omitting request-local limits retain existing policy; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_settings_builders_seam.py tests/unit/test_runner_hardening.py`.
- [x] The held-out oracle returns RED when the overlap-local limits are removed; checked by the recorded mutation run.
- [x] Focused tests, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` exit 0.
- [x] An overlap-enabled original-path replication abstains within the declared bound and returns no fabricated overlap finding; evidence recorded on `rebar:22da-e9a6-63e7-49e5` with elapsed time, output/finish diagnostic, result, and timestamp.
